string-array.name: move_squat_steps
string-array.item: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, toes turned slightly out.
Push your hips back and bend your knees until your thighs are about level with the floor.
Press through your whole foot to stand up again.

resources.string: Keep your heels on the floor and your knees pointing the same way as your toes.

string-array.name: move_push_up_steps
string-array.item: Place your hands a little wider than your shoulders, body straight from head to heels.
Bend your elbows and lower your chest towards the floor.
Push back up until your arms are straight.

resources.string: Keep your belly tight so your hips don\'t sag. Too hard? Start with your knees on the floor.

string-array.name: move_glute_bridge_steps
string-array.item: Lie on your back with bent knees and your feet flat on the floor.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your hips until your body is straight from knees to shoulders.
Lower slowly back down.

resources.string: Push through your heels and avoid arching your lower back.

string-array.name: move_split_squat_steps
string-array.item: Stand with one foot a long step in front of the other, up on the toes of the back foot.
Lower straight down until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Push up through the front foot. Do all repetitions, then switch legs.

resources.string: Keep your upper body upright and your front knee over your foot.

string-array.name: move_jumping_jack_steps
string-array.item: Stand with your feet together and your arms by your sides.
Jump your feet apart while your arms swing up over your head.
Jump back to the start and keep a steady pace.

resources.string: Land softly on the balls of your feet.

string-array.name: move_calf_raise_steps
string-array.item: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart. Hold on to a wall for balance if you like.
Rise up onto the balls of your feet as high as you can.
Lower your heels slowly back to the floor.

resources.string: Go slowly, especially on the way down.

string-array.name: move_plank_steps
string-array.item: Place your hands under your shoulders and your feet hip-width apart.
Lift your body so it is straight from head to heels.
Hold the position and keep breathing calmly.

resources.string: Squeeze your belly and glutes so your hips neither sag nor rise.

string-array.name: move_mountain_climber_steps
string-array.item: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Pull one knee towards your chest, then put the foot back.
Switch legs in a steady rhythm.

resources.string: Keep your hips low and your shoulders over your hands.

string-array.name: move_superman_steps
string-array.item: Lie on your stomach with your arms stretched out in front of you.
Lift your arms, chest and legs a little off the floor at the same time.
Hold for a moment, then lower slowly.

resources.string: Look at the floor so your neck stays long. Lifting a few centimetres is enough.

string-array.name: move_reverse_lunge_steps
string-array.item: Stand with your feet hip-width apart.
Take a long step back and lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Push off with the front foot back to standing. Do all repetitions, then switch legs.

resources.string: Keep most of your weight on the front foot.

string-array.name: move_good_morning_steps
string-array.item: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your knees soft.
Push your hips back and lean forward with a straight back until you feel a stretch in the back of your thighs.
Squeeze your glutes and rise back up.

resources.string: Move from your hips, not your back, and keep your back straight the whole time.

string-array.name: move_bird_dog_steps
string-array.item: Get on your hands and knees, hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
Stretch one arm forward and the opposite leg back until both are level with your back.
Return slowly and switch sides.

resources.string: Keep your back still, as if a glass of water were standing on it.

string-array.name: move_crunch_steps
string-array.item: Lie on your back with bent knees and your feet on the floor.
Tighten your belly and curl your shoulders off the floor, reaching for your knees.
Lower slowly back down.

resources.string: Your lower back stays on the floor. Don\'t pull on your neck.

string-array.name: move_arm_raise_steps
string-array.item: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your arms by your sides.
Raise both straight arms in front of you until they are about level with your shoulders.
Lower them slowly back down.

resources.string: Raise from the shoulder, without shrugging or leaning back.

string-array.name: move_neck_nod_steps
string-array.item: Stand or sit tall and look straight ahead.
Nod slowly, bringing your chin down towards your chest.
Return just as slowly to looking straight ahead.

resources.string: Keep the movement small and slow. Stop if it hurts.

string-array.name: move_knee_push_up_steps
string-array.item: Kneel with your hands a little wider than your shoulders and your body straight from knees to head.
Bend your elbows and lower your chest towards the floor.
Press up until your arms are straight.

resources.string: The same push-up with less weight. When 12 feel easy, try a few from your toes.

string-array.name: move_single_leg_bridge_steps
string-array.item: Lie on your back with one foot on the floor and the other leg straight, in line with the thigh.
Push through your heel and lift your hips until your body is straight from knee to shoulders.
Lower slowly, then switch legs.

resources.string: Keep your hips level, so they don\'t drop to the side of the straight leg.

string-array.name: move_dead_bug_steps
string-array.item: Lie on your back with your arms pointing up and your hips and knees at right angles.
Slowly reach one arm overhead and straighten the opposite leg, just above the floor.
Bring them back and switch sides.

resources.string: Press your lower back gently into the floor the whole time. Breathe out as you reach.

string-array.name: move_high_knees_steps
string-array.item: Stand tall with your elbows bent.
Run in place, driving one knee up to hip height.
Switch legs quickly and swing your arms along.

resources.string: Land softly on the balls of your feet. Lower the knees for a quieter version.

string-array.name: move_goblet_squat_steps
string-array.item: Hold one dumbbell upright against your chest, feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit down between your heels with your chest up until your thighs are level.
Push through your heels to stand up.

resources.string: Keep your elbows in and the weight close to your chest.

string-array.name: move_dumbbell_row_steps
string-array.item: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and hinge forward with soft knees and a flat back.
Pull the dumbbells up to your lower ribs, elbows close to your body.
Lower them slowly until your arms are straight.

resources.string: Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top, and keep your neck in line with your back.

string-array.name: move_dumbbell_press_steps
string-array.item: Stand tall with a dumbbell at each shoulder, elbows in front of you.
Press the dumbbells straight up until your arms are straight.
Lower them slowly back to your shoulders.

resources.string: Brace your stomach so your lower back doesn\'t arch.

string-array.name: move_biceps_curl_steps
string-array.item: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, arms straight.
Bend your elbows and curl the dumbbells up to your shoulders.
Lower them slowly until your arms are straight.

resources.string: Keep your elbows by your sides and let your arms do the work, not your back.

string-array.name: move_dumbbell_deadlift_steps
string-array.item: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Push your hips back with soft knees and a flat back, the weights close to your legs.
Stop when you feel the back of your thighs, then push your hips forward to stand up.

resources.string: The movement comes from the hips. Keep your back flat all the way.

string-array.name: move_band_row_steps
string-array.item: Anchor a band at chest height and hold an end in each hand, arms straight in front.
Pull your elbows back along your sides until your hands reach your ribs.
Let your arms out slowly.

resources.string: Squeeze your shoulder blades together and keep your shoulders down.

string-array.name: move_band_pulldown_steps
string-array.item: Anchor a band high in front of you and hold it with straight arms reaching up.
Pull your arms down to your thighs, keeping them almost straight.
Let them back up slowly.

resources.string: Brace your stomach and stand still; only your arms move.

string-array.name: move_band_chest_press_steps
string-array.item: Anchor a band behind you at chest height and hold an end in each hand at your chest.
Press your hands straight forward until your arms are straight.
Bring them back slowly.

resources.string: Take a small step forward if the band is too light, and keep your wrists straight.

string-array.name: move_front_squat_steps
string-array.item: Rest the bar on the front of your shoulders, elbows high and forward.
Sit down between your heels with an upright chest until your thighs are level.
Push through your heels to stand up.

resources.string: Keep your elbows high so the bar stays on your shoulders. Start with a light bar.

string-array.name: move_deadlift_steps
string-array.item: Stand tall holding the bar in front of your thighs, hands just outside your legs.
Push your hips back with soft knees and a flat back, sliding the bar down your thighs.
Stop below your knees and push your hips forward to stand up.

resources.string: Keep the bar close to your legs and your back flat. Start with a light bar.

string-array.name: move_barbell_row_steps
string-array.item: Hold the bar with straight arms and hinge forward with soft knees and a flat back.
Pull the bar up to your lower ribs.
Lower it slowly until your arms are straight.

resources.string: Keep your back still: if you need to swing, the bar is too heavy.
